(2) DEFENSE - ALL 11 starters gone incl. 3 All-SEC front-seven stars (Young/Wilson pro-or-Miami, Trotter pro); Batoon reloads via the portal (Woodyard/Auburn, Graves/Ole Miss, Florence/Oregon) + returning Gracial/Rodriguez, but it's a near-total rebuild off a #8 unit.
